# Timezone

`c.Timezone` calls the API's Timezone group. The timezone of the host.

### Get

```go
func (s *TimezoneService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[TimezoneEntry]], error)
```

Get the timezone of the host.

Reads the IANA name of the timezone and its offset from UTC now: the zone that
/etc/localtime links to, or /etc/timezone on Linux.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/timezone`, and needs the permission
`timezone:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A Linux host on UTC, `go run timezone.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Timezone.Get(ctx, target)
```

### Update

```go
func (s *TimezoneService) Update(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input TimezoneUpdateInput,
) (*Response[Collection[TimezoneResult]], error)
```

Set the timezone of the host.

Sets the timezone with timedatectl set-timezone. A host that already has the
timezone does not change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian
family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.

It sends `PUT /api/node/{hostname}/timezone`, and needs the permission
`timezone:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Set a new timezone, `go run timezone.go update`:

```go
resp, err := c.Timezone.Update(ctx, target, client.TimezoneUpdateInput{Timezone: "America/New_York"})
```

A host that already has the timezone, `go run timezone.go update-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Timezone.Update(ctx, target, client.TimezoneUpdateInput{Timezone: "UTC"})
```
